Put Jhave's face photo here to get the JibJab look:

  jhave.png   (best: a cut-out face on a transparent background)
  jhave.jpg   (also fine: it will be cropped to an oval with a white paper edge)

Optional:
  jhave-grimace.png / jhave-grimace.jpg   (used when the crowd hisses)

Frame the photo tightly around the face (chin to top of head), facing forward.
The jaw splits at 70% of the image height for the flapping-mouth effect; tweak
FACE_JAW in game.js if the cut lands in the wrong place.

Without a photo, a generic cartoon face is used.
